data.name: Jonell
data.long_meaning: The name Jonell has roots in both Hebrew and Greek languages. In Hebrew, it is derived from the word 'Yonah,' which means 'dove.' In Greek, the name 'Jonas' means 'God's gift.' Thus, Jonell is a beautiful blend of these two meanings, conveying the idea of a graceful woman who is a divine gift from God.
